'''Falkenbergs Fotbollsförening''', also known simply as '''Falkenbergs FF''', '''Falkenberg''' or (especially locally) '''FFF''',  is a Swedish [[association football|football]] club based in [[Falkenberg]]. Formed on 3 January 1928, the club plays in the second highest Swedish league, [[Superettan]]. Falkenberg are affiliated with [[Hallands Fotbollförbund]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=8 |title= Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar – Hallands Fotbollförbund – Svenskfotboll.se |access-date=12 January 2011}}</ref>"}}
